content:
## What is FileTools?

FileTools.eu is a free online file conversion platform. PDF to Word, image resizing, format conversion, compression — the usual suspects, but executed cleanly.

## What makes it different

Most free conversion sites are minefields of ads and dark patterns. FileTools takes a different approach: minimal interface, fast processing, no mandatory account creation.

The tool handles common conversions: PDF to DOCX, PNG to JPG, image compression, PDF merging and splitting. Processing happens server-side and files are deleted after conversion.

## Supported formats

PDF, DOCX, XLSX, PNG, JPG, WEBP, SVG, GIF, and more. The converter recognizes input format automatically and suggests output options.

## Privacy

Files are processed and deleted. No account required for basic conversions. The site uses HTTPS and doesn't require cookies for core functionality.

## Verdict

If you need quick file conversions without the usual web tool annoyances, FileTools delivers. Bookmarkable for those regular PDF-to-Word moments.
